review_candidates.title: Network Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Role Description The Network Administrator will be responsible for managing, monitoring, and maintaining the company’s network and systems to ensure stable and secure connectivity across the mobile shop location in Cairo, Egypt. The Network Administrator will implement and maintain network security measures, including firewalls, antivirus solutions, and access controls, while keeping documentation and network diagrams up to date. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong skills in Network
eligibility_evidence: This full-time, on-site role involves daily tasks such as configuring routers, switches, and access points, overseeing user access and permissions, and performing routine network health checks and backups.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications Candidates should possess strong skills in Network Administration and System Administration, including configuration, monitoring, and maintenance of network devices and servers.
